verdict.rationale: The closest fit is EFILE. Enrolled electronic filers transmit many clients' returns system-to-system from certified third-party software, including current and prior years and amended T1s via ReFILE, and can view transmission history. That is a multi-item channel, but it is limited to tax-return filing and depends on vendor software. Registering a BN and several program accounts on one form is a bundled single transaction, not a bulk operation. Missing for 10: explicit batch or bulk-operation documentation, bulk actions across other item types (payments, registrations, documents), a first-party API or tooling for bulk work without certified third-party software, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
